metadata.description: This is the broadcast for Equalizing-X-Distort for Sunday, November 24th, 2019. EXD is a weekly hardcore punk show broadcast live on CIUT every Sunday nights at 10;00pm. Tonight's show starts out with features on Hamilton and Winnpieg because their teams just played in the Grey Cup final today. There is another feature on contemporary hardcore from New Zealand. And a lot of new releases.
